verdict.rationale: Evidence shows CMS IndusLaw advises both venture/PE funds (induslaw-supp-funds, induslaw-supp-private-equity) and startups/founders (induslaw-supp-startup-report, induslaw-supp-esop), plus a broad client base spanning 'corporates, investors, funds... start-ups' (induslaw-supp-clients), implying dual-side market knowledge in venture financing. However, there is no explicit statement that the firm tracks or advises on 'current market terms' across term sheets/cap tables from both founder and investor perspectives in the same deals. Missing for 10: explicit market-terms benchmarking content, named venture financing deal-term publications, and direct evidence of representing both sides in the same transactions.
